page_title: BRE 0-1 ARS | Brentford v Arsenal 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ben White (Arsenal) replacing Bukayo Saka.
90+3' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Martin Odegaard and he is replaced by Jorginho (Arsenal).
90+1' A substitution has been made. Frank Onyeka is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Zanka (Brentford) replaces Saman Ghoddos.

89' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Kai Havertz (Arsenal) rises high to head the ball low into the middle of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
88' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

85' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Mark Flekken has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
84' It looked like the long-range shot by William Saliba (Arsenal) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
82' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
80' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
79' Here comes a substitution. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Martinelli.
77' Neal Maupay (Brentford) receives a pinpoint pass, takes one touch and produces a shot. It's a few inches shy of ending inside the left post. A great effort, though!
73' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
73' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
72' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) replaces Yegor Yarmolyuk.
72' It will be a substitution. Neal Maupay (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Yoane Wissa walks off.
71' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Aaron Ramsdale and he's equal to it.
69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
68' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
66' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Gabriel Jesus is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
63' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
62' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) sends a chip pass into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale is quickest to intercept the ball.
60' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
56' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
52' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
52' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
49' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
46' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A cross into the box picks out Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
45+3' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45+2' A free kick to Arsenal.
45+1' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The goal by Arsenal won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
43' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
42' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
41' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Arsenal have a corner.
39' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar.
38' A lofted cross from Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) sends the corner into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts it and averts the threat.
32' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
31' Gabriel (Arsenal) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
31' The referee awards a corner and Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take it.

31' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner.
30' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
29' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' Oleksandr Zinchenko clips a neat ball into the box towards Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
23' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
22' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

21' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Arsenal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
16' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Arsenal earn a corner.
14' Wow, what an escape. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
11' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick, but Mark Flekken reads it well and stops the effort.
10' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
8' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
